dataflows

object

Data Datadog collects from OpenAI Codex, keyed by dataflow id. Daily Codex analytics metrics are always collected; each dataflow here adds a further kind of collection on top of that baseline, so set enabled to start or stop it. Defaults listed on each dataflow apply when the account is created; on update, omitted fields keep their current values. Every dataflow requires an OpenAI enterprise subscription with Codex enabled; a dataflow enabled without it is stored but collects no data.

object

A daily per-engineer engagement signal that AI Impact uses to attribute AI-assisted pull requests.

enabled

boolean

Whether Datadog collects this data. Defaults to true; set to false to stop collection.

Turn cost is a provider estimate and can differ from invoiced charges. Requires the chatgpt.enterprise.compliance_logs_platform.workspace_analytics.read scope on the key in authentication; without it this dataflow collects no data.

enabled

boolean

Whether Datadog collects this data. Defaults to false; set to true to start collection.

request.html:
data [required]

object

Data envelope for updating an OpenAI Codex integration account.

attributes [required]

object

Writable attributes used to update an OpenAI Codex integration account. Every field is optional; only the fields provided are changed. When dataflows is provided, only the dataflow ids included in the request are modified; dataflows omitted from the map keep their current configuration.

authentication

 <oneOf>

Authentication for updating the OpenAI Codex integration account. Exactly one method is set.

<auth_type=bearer_token>

object

Bearer token authentication. Use a workspace-scoped OpenAI Admin key with the codex.enterprise.analytics.read scope. Only the fields provided are changed; omit token to keep the stored one.

auth_type [required]

enum

The authentication method type. Allowed enum values: bearer_token

default: bearer_token

token

string

Secret token used to authenticate with OpenAI Codex.

dataflows

object

Data Datadog collects from OpenAI Codex, keyed by dataflow id. Daily Codex analytics metrics are always collected; each dataflow here adds a further kind of collection on top of that baseline, so set enabled to start or stop it. Defaults listed on each dataflow apply when the account is created; on update, omitted fields keep their current values. Every dataflow requires an OpenAI enterprise subscription with Codex enabled; a dataflow enabled without it is stored but collects no data.

openai-codex-dora

object

A daily per-engineer engagement signal that AI Impact uses to attribute AI-assisted pull requests.

enabled

boolean

Whether Datadog collects this data. Defaults to true; set to false to stop collection.

openai-codex-turn-metrics

object

Hourly turn-level metrics from the OpenAI Compliance Logs Platform, including turn and session identity, Work Insights classification, token usage, credits, estimated cost, duration, and skill, plugin, and artifact activity. Turn cost is a provider estimate and can differ from invoiced charges. Requires the chatgpt.enterprise.compliance_logs_platform.workspace_analytics.read scope on the key in authentication; without it this dataflow collects no data.

enabled

boolean

Whether Datadog collects this data. Defaults to false; set to true to start collection.

name

string

Human-readable name of the OpenAI Codex integration account.

settings

object

Settings for updating the OpenAI Codex integration account. Only the fields provided are changed.

codex_workspace_id

string

ID of the Codex workspace to collect data from.

id [required]

string

Unique identifier of the OpenAI Codex integration account to update.

type [required]

enum

The type of the integration account resource. Always integration-account. Allowed enum values: integration-account

default: integration-account
